content.title: Audio Plugin Preset Management and Browser Design
content.overview: Best practices for designing intuitive preset management systems and patch browsers for audio plugins

levels: Categories - functional groups (Pads, Basses, Leads, Keys)
Presets - individual sounds (128 max per bank for manageability)
hierarchical_structure.nesting: Support nested folders and subfolders for deeper organization

naming_conventions: Include plugin name and version (e.g., 'Serum v1.2 - Bright Lead')
Use descriptive names with characteristics ('Warm Pad', 'Aggressive Bass')
Avoid special characters and spaces for cross-platform compatibility

multi_modal_search.text_search: Keyword and phrase search across names, folders, metadata
multi_modal_search.favorites: Allow users to star/mark frequently used presets

tag_best_practices: Fewer accurate tags better than over-tagging
Consistent tag vocabulary across preset library

essential_fields: Author name - for credit and filtering
Description - explain unique features and recommended uses
Macro labels - name custom macro controls
Version info - track versions and compatibility
visual_preview: Show metadata in right panel when preset selected
Indicate third-party vs factory presets visually

layout_patterns.three_column_layout: Folders → Preset list → Metadata details (for complex plugins)
layout_patterns.expandable_browser: Pin to side of plugin GUI to save space

interaction_patterns: Instant preview - load presets immediately on selection
Right-click context menus - rename, delete, export, show in filesystem
Clear visual indicator - show current loaded preset

smart_save_dialog: Use OS native save dialogs for familiarity
Default to plugin preset directory with custom location option
Auto-assign ID numbers (1-128) if not specified
version_management: Confirm overwrite warnings for existing presets

import_export_system: Export entire collections as single distributable files
Import collections as new entries in browser
meta_preset_management: Store plugin state + host application data together
Create universal sound libraries across different synths
Support VST3/AU plugin hosting within manager
morphing_modulation: XY pad for 2D vector morphing between snapshots
Physics-based elastic modes for organic transitions
MIDI trigger support for live performance

efficiency_considerations: Fast mode - recall only parameter values (not full state) for simple synths
Sanity mode - protect 'danger' parameters (volume, pitch, bypass)
CPU management - avoid morphing thousands of parameters simultaneously
daw_integration: Expose automation parameters for morphing and macros
Support MIDI CC for bank/preset selection
Address DAW limitations (e.g., Ableton's 128 parameter threshold)

familiar_patterns: Reference OS-native UX (macOS Finder, iOS search)
Maintain consistent browser location across plugins
accessibility: Provide clear visual feedback for all actions
Include confirmation dialogs for destructive operations
progressive_disclosure: Full browser with search/filter for complex instruments
Collapsible panels to maximize screen real estate

common_pitfalls: Overly complex hierarchy - keep structure shallow
Slow search performance - optimize with indexing
Missing metadata - makes presets hard to find
No backup system - users lose work when reinstalling
